mentions.name: Reverse Engineering Platform on FreeBSD
mentions.description: This is a reverse engineering platform built for FreeBSD, written as the author's first C++ project. It restricts itself to libraries natively supported on FreeBSD rather than relying on ports, and is GUI-first, featuring standard and unique visualization ideas for the involved processes and data. It is intentionally a manual-mode project, kept free of LLM-supported or agentic workflows.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a reverse engineering platform on FreeBSD. i know there are many tools but i want to learn more about them aswell as most if not all of them being ports, so i focus on using only libraries natively supported on FreeBSD just as an added requirement.
